newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Information Storage raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Information Storage raised.

text.p: -- Robertson Stephens & Co said analyst Dan Klesken raised his rating on shares of Information Storage Devices Inc to long term attractive from market performer based on recent design wins and its outlook for profitability in 1997.
-- Thursday, the company reported a Q4 loss of $0.15 a share on revenues of $9.7 million versus a profit of $0.15 a share on revenues of $12.6 million last year.

-- Klesken called the Q4 earnings report "better than expected". He noted the company reported a 1.19 book-to-bill ratio and 10 new design wins, eight of which were from wireless communications companies.
